readings.title: The Torah of the Guilt Offering
readings.subtitle: Atonement and Provision
readings.text:
[Leviticus 7:1] <dq>‘And this is the Torah of the guilt offering – it is most set-apart.</dq>
[2] <dq>‘The guilt offering is slain in the place where they slay <dn>את</dn> the ascending offering, and <dn>את</dn> its blood is sprinkled on the slaughter-place all around.</dq>
[3] <dq>‘Then he brings from it <dn>את</dn> all its fat: <dn>את</dn> the fat tail and <dn>את</dn> the fat that covers <dn>את</dn> the entrails,</dq>
[4] <dq>and <dn>את</dn> the two kidneys and <dn>את</dn> the fat that is on them by the loins, and <dn>את</dn> the appendage on the liver, which he removes with the kidneys.</dq>
[5] <dq>‘And the priest shall burn <dn>את</dn> them on the slaughter-place as an offering made by fire to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. It is a guilt offering.</dq>
[6] <dq>‘Every male among the priests eats it. It is eaten in the set-apart place, it is most set-apart.</dq>
[7] <dq>‘The guilt offering is like the sin offering, there is one Torah for them both: the priest who makes atonement with it, it is his.</dq>
[8] <dq>‘And the priest who brings <dn>את</dn> anyone’s ascending offering, the skin of the ascending offering which he has brought is the priest’s, it is his.</dq>
[9] <dq>‘And every grain offering that is baked in the oven and all that is prepared in the stewing-pot, or on a griddle, is the priest’s who brings <dn>את</dn> it, it is his.</dq>
[10] <dq>‘And every grain offering mixed with oil, or dry, is for all the sons of Aharon, for all alike.</dq>

readings.title: The Torah of the Peace Offerings
readings.subtitle: Thanksgiving and Vows
readings.text:
[Leviticus 7:11] <dq>‘And this is the Torah of the slaughtering of peace offerings which is brought to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>:</dq>
[12] <dq>‘If he brings it for a thanksgiving, then he shall bring with the slaughtering of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened thin cakes anointed with oil, or cakes of finely blended flour mixed with oil.</dq>
[13] <dq>‘Besides the cakes, he brings as his offering leavened bread together with the slaughtering of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.</dq>
[14] <dq>‘And from it he shall bring one cake from each offering as a contribution to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>: to the priest who sprinkles <dn>את</dn> the blood of the peace offerings, it is his.</dq>
[15] <dq>‘As for the flesh of the slaughtering of his peace offerings for thanksgiving, it is eaten the same day it is offered, he does not leave any of it until morning.</dq>
[16] <dq>‘And if the slaughtering he brings is a vow or a voluntary offering, it is eaten the same day that he brings <dn>את</dn> his slaughtering, and what is left of it is eaten the next day,</dq>
[17] <dq>but whatever is left of the flesh of the slaughtering on the third day is burned with fire.</dq>
[18] <dq>‘However, if any of the flesh of the slaughtering of his peace offerings is eaten at all on the third day, it is not accepted. It is not reckoned to him who brings <dn>את</dn> it, it is unclean to him, and the being who eats of it bears his crookedness.</dq>
[19] <dq>‘And the flesh that touches that which is unclean is not eaten, it is burned with fire. And as for the clean flesh, all who are clean eat of it.</dq>
[20] <dq>‘But the being who eats the flesh of the slaughtering of peace offerings that belongs to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, while he is unclean, that being shall be cut off from his people.</dq>
[21] <dq>‘And when a being who touches that which is unclean, of the uncleanness of man, or of the uncleanness of beast, or of any unclean abomination, and shall eat the flesh of the slaughtering of peace offerings that belongs to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, that being shall be cut off from his people.’ ”</dq>

readings.title: The Prohibition of Fat and Blood
readings.subtitle: The Penalty of Being Cut Off
readings.text:
[Leviticus 7:22] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying,
[23] <dq>“Speak to the children of Yisra’ěl, saying, ‘Do not eat any fat, of bull or sheep or goat.</dq>
[24] <dq>‘And the fat of a dead body, and the fat of what is torn, is used for any purpose, but you do not eat it at all.</dq>
[25] <dq>‘For whoever eats the fat of the beast of which men bring as an offering made by fire to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, even the being who eats it shall be cut off from his people.</dq>
[26] <dq>‘And do not eat any blood in any of your dwellings, of bird or of beast.</dq>
[27] <dq>‘Any being who eats any blood, even that being shall be cut off from his people.’ ”</dq>

readings.title: The Wave and Contribution Offerings
readings.subtitle: The Anointed Portion for Aharon and His Sons
readings.text:
[Leviticus 7:28] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying,
[29] <dq>“Speak to the children of Yisra’ěl, saying, ‘He who brings <dn>את</dn> his slaughtering of peace offerings to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> brings <dn>את</dn> his offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> from the slaughtering of his peace offerings.</dq>
[30] <dq>‘With his own hands he brings <dn>את</dn> the offerings made by fire to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. He brings <dn>את</dn> the fat with <dn>את</dn> the breast, to be waved as a wave offering before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq>
[31] <dq>‘And the priest shall burn <dn>את</dn> the fat on the slaughter-place, but the breast shall be Aharon’s and his sons.’</dq>
[32] <dq>‘And <dn>את</dn> the right thigh you give to the priest as a contribution from the slaughtering of your peace offerings.</dq>
[33] <dq>‘He among the sons of Aharon, who brings <dn>את</dn> the blood of the peace offerings, and <dn>את</dn> the fat, the right thigh is his for a portion.</dq>
[34] <dq>‘For <dn>את</dn> the breast of the wave offering and <dn>את</dn> the thigh of the contribution <dn>I</dn> have taken from <dn>את</dn> the children of Yisra’ěl, from the slaughterings of their peace offerings, and <dn>I</dn> give <dn>את</dn> them to Aharon the priest and to his sons, as a law forever, from <dn>את</dn> the children of Yisra’ěl.’ ”</dq>
[35] This is the anointed portion for Aharon and the anointed portion for his sons, from the offerings made by fire to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, on the day when Mosheh presented <dn>את</dn> them to serve as priests to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>,
[36] which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded to be given to them by the children of Yisra’ěl, on the day that <dn>He</dn> anointed <dn>את</dn> them, a law forever throughout their generations.
[37] This is the Torah of the ascending offering, of the grain offering, and of the sin offering, and of the guilt offering, and of the ordinations, and of the slaughtering of peace offerings,
[38] which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh on Mount Sinai, on the day when <dn>He</dn> commanded <dn>את</dn> the children of Yisra’ěl to bring <dn>את</dn> their offerings to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, in the Wilderness of Sinai.

readings.title: The Consecration of Aharon and His Sons
readings.subtitle: The Seven Days of Ordination
readings.text:
[Leviticus 8:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying,
[2] <dq>“Take <dn>את</dn> Aharon and <dn>את</dn> his sons with <dn>את</dn> him, and <dn>את</dn> the garments, and <dn>את</dn> the anointing oil, and <dn>את</dn> the bull of the sin offering, and <dn>את</dn> the two rams, and <dn>את</dn> the basket of unleavened bread,</dq>
[3] <dq>and assemble <dn>את</dn> all the congregation at the door of the Tent of Appointment.”</dq>
[4] And Mosheh did as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded <dn>את</dn> him, and the congregation was assembled at the door of the Tent of Appointment.
[5] And Mosheh said to the congregation, “This is the word <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded to be done.”
[6] So Mosheh brought <dn>את</dn> Aharon and <dn>את</dn> his sons and washed <dn>את</dn> them with water,
[7] and put <dn>את</dn> the long shirt on him, and girded <dn>את</dn> him with the girdle, and dressed <dn>את</dn> him in <dn>את</dn> the robe, and put <dn>את</dn> the shoulder garment on him, and girded <dn>את</dn> him with the embroidered band of the shoulder garment, and with it tied the shoulder garment on him,
[8] and put <dn>את</dn> the breastplate on him, and put <dn>את</dn> the Urim and <dn>את</dn> the Tummim in the breastplate,
[9] and put <dn>את</dn> the turban on his head. And on the turban, on its front, he put <dn>את</dn> the golden plate, the set-apart sign of dedication, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh.
[10] And Mosheh took <dn>את</dn> the anointing oil and anointed <dn>את</dn> the Dwelling Place and <dn>את</dn> all that was in it, and set <dn>את</dn> them apart.
[11] And he sprinkled some of it on the slaughter-place seven times, and anointed <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-place and <dn>את</dn> all its utensils, and <dn>את</dn> the basin and <dn>את</dn> its base, to set them apart.
[12] And he poured some of the anointing oil on Aharon’s head and anointed <dn>את</dn> him, to set him apart.
[13] And Mosheh brought <dn>את</dn> the sons of Aharon and put long shirts on them, and girded <dn>את</dn> them with girdles, and put turbans on them, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh.
[14] And he brought <dn>את</dn> the bull for the sin offering, and Aharon and his sons laid <dn>את</dn> their hands on the head of the bull for the sin offering,
[15] and it was slain. And Mosheh took <dn>את</dn> the blood, and put some on the horns of the slaughter-place all around with his finger, and cleansed <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-place. And he poured <dn>את</dn> the blood at the base of the slaughter-place, and set it apart, to make atonement for it.
[16] And he took <dn>את</dn> all the fat that was on the entrails, and <dn>את</dn> the appendage on the liver, and <dn>את</dn> the two kidneys with <dn>את</dn> their fat, and Mosheh burned them on the slaughter-place.
[17] And <dn>את</dn> the bull, and <dn>את</dn> its skin, and <dn>את</dn> its flesh, and <dn>את</dn> its dung, he burned with fire outside the camp, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh.
[18] And he brought <dn>את</dn> the ram of the ascending offering, and Aharon and his sons laid <dn>את</dn> their hands on the head of the ram,
[19] and it was slain. And Mosheh sprinkled <dn>את</dn> the blood on the slaughter-place all around,
[20] and he cut <dn>את</dn> the ram into pieces. And Mosheh burned <dn>את</dn> the head, and <dn>את</dn> the pieces, and <dn>את</dn> the fat,
[21] and he washed <dn>את</dn> the entrails and <dn>את</dn> the legs in water. And Mosheh burned <dn>את</dn> the entire ram on the slaughter-place. It was an ascending offering for a sweet fragrance, and an offering made by fire to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh.
[22] And he brought <dn>את</dn> the second ram, the ram of ordination, and Aharon and his sons laid <dn>את</dn> their hands on the head of the ram,
[23] and it was slain. And Mosheh took some of its blood and put it on the tip of Aharon’s right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.
[24] And he brought near <dn>את</dn> the sons of Aharon, and Mosheh put some of the blood on the tips of their right ears, and on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet. And Mosheh sprinkled <dn>את</dn> the blood on the slaughter-place all around,
[25] and took <dn>את</dn> the fat and <dn>את</dn> the fat tail, and <dn>את</dn> all the fat that was on the entrails, and <dn>את</dn> the appendage on the liver, and <dn>את</dn> the two kidneys and <dn>את</dn> their fat, and <dn>את</dn> the right thigh,
[26] and from the basket of unleavened bread that was before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of bread anointed with oil, and one thin cake, and put them on the fat and on the right thigh,
[27] and placed <dn>את</dn> all these in the hands of Aharon and in the hands of his sons, and waved <dn>את</dn> them as a wave offering before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.
[28] Mosheh then took <dn>את</dn> them from their hands and burned them on the slaughter-place, on the ascending offering. They were ordinations for a sweet fragrance. It was an offering by fire to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.
[29] And Mosheh took <dn>את</dn> the breast and waved it, a wave offering before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. It was Mosheh’s portion of the ram of ordination, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh.
[30] And Mosheh took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood which was on the slaughter-place, and sprinkled it on Aharon, on his garments, and on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him. And he set apart <dn>את</dn> Aharon, <dn>את</dn> his garments, and <dn>את</dn> his sons, and <dn>את</dn> the garments of his sons with <dn>את</dn> him.
[31] And Mosheh said to Aharon and his sons, “Cook <dn>את</dn> the flesh at the door of the Tent of Appointment, and eat <dn>את</dn> it there with <dn>את</dn> the bread that is in the basket of the ordinations, as I have commanded, saying, ‘Aharon and his sons are to eat it.’
[32] “Then burn the rest of the flesh and the bread with fire.
[33] “And do not go outside the door of the Tent of Appointment for seven days, until the days of your ordination are completed – for he fills <dn>את</dn> your hands for seven days.
[34] “<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has commanded to do, as he has done this day, to make atonement for you.
[35] “And stay at the door of the Tent of Appointment day and night for seven days. And you shall guard <dn>את</dn> the duty of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and not die, for so I have been commanded.”
[36] And Aharon and his sons did <dn>את</dn> all the words that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded by the hand of Mosheh.
